name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Sylhet Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)
organization: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the earlier division runs (no text layer). Sylhet Division's offices are at the start of the booklet's 'চট্টগ্রাম রিজিয়ন ৩০০০-৪৯৯৯': p. 13 (PDF page 8, right half, from 'সুনামগঞ্জ জেলা ৩০০০-৩০৯৯': Sunamganj and the start of the Sylhet head-office group; faded print), p. 14 (PDF page 9, left half: Sylhet, Moulvibazar, Habiganj) and p. 15 (PDF page 9, right half, first column, up to 'ব্রাহ্মণবাড়ীয়া জেলা ৩৪০০-৩৪৯৯', Chattogram Division, already collected); only these were transcribed, by hand, from the page images (raw/postcode_booklet_pp12-13.png = PDF page 8 at its native 150 dpi, rotated; raw/postcode_booklet_pp14-15.png = PDF page 9, the same file as in the Chattogram folder). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Seven offices have an illegible or misprinted code (postcode left empty); five rows that cannot be read (three on p. 13, Chhatak group; two on p. 14, Barlekha group, of which only 'জুরি' / 'দক্ষি…' and code 3252 are legible) are left out; eight name readings are uncertain or unclear (flagged). Branch post offices are not in the booklet. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
